tasks.name: search_then_detail
tasks.prompt: Search for clinical trials related to sleep, then retrieve full details for the first result.

tasks.name: aggregate_then_example
tasks.prompt: Show the number of clinical trials in each trial phase, then search for one sleep trial as a supporting example.

tasks.name: compare_two_trials
tasks.prompt: First call search_trials using exactly {"query": "Study", "limit": 4}. From that result, select two different trial IDs. Call trial_details once for the first ID and once for the second ID. Then compare the two trials by title, phase, sponsor, and enrollment target.

error_case.name: impossible_trial_id
error_case.prompt: Retrieve details for clinical trial ID 999999999. If it does not exist, explain the tool error without crashing.
